ITEM.PTXT: If the battery fluid temperature is too low or too high, it can accelerate battery deterioration or cause the battery to discharge. Also, since the current acceptance characteristics change with battery fluid temperature, the battery is protected by detecting the battery fluid temperature and sending a signal to the engine control computer.
The battery temperature sensor is built into the battery current sensor. As a result, the sensor is located near the negative terminal, where it is less affected by engine heat.
